The '''Nicandra Counterrevolutionary Signalmen's Memorial Building''' (or the '''Nicandra Building''' for short)<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> was located in [[Nicandra Plaza]] in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was a dome-shaped building, and its midlevel contained [[Embassy Mall]].<ref name="CL" />
